title: RealHandles signed proof (v1)
description: A RealHandles artifact: either a full signed manifest (the portable, self-verifying proof that a set of accounts belongs to one holder of an Ed25519 key) or a signed anchor pointer (hosted once at a location the holder controls, pointing to the canonical manifest). In both cases the compact JWS in `jws` is authoritative; the mirrored JSON fields are a convenience for humans and must never be trusted over the decoded, signature-verified payload.

ed25519PublicJwk.description: An Ed25519 public key as a JWK (RFC 8037).

platform.description: Platform key, e.g. "github", "x", or "domain" for a controlled domain.

handle.description: The username on that platform, or the domain itself.

method.description: How control was proven. First-party methods (oauth, tweet-proof, post-proof, description-proof, atproto, domain-control, domain-anchor) are Verified; anything else is a self-asserted Claim.

entity.description: Present when the account is an organization or server the holder runs, rather than a personal profile.

image.description: Logo/icon URL for an organization or server account.

builder.description: For a link-in-bio (rel=me) account, the recognized page builder (e.g. "lilhub"). Cosmetic label only; never a trust signal.

url.description: Where the signed anchor file is hosted.

domain.description: For a domain anchor, the domain itself.

keyId.description: base64url(SHA-256(canonical public JWK)): the stable fingerprint verifiers pin.

jws.description: Compact JWS (EdDSA/Ed25519) whose payload is the manifest. Authoritative.
Compact JWS (EdDSA/Ed25519) whose payload is the pointer. Authoritative.
